import html # Template for the invitation. Use double curly braces so that .format() can # replace them safely without executing any code. INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def render_event_invitation( event_title: str, event_description: str, event_date: str, additional_notes: str ) -> str: """ Render a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- event_title : str Title of the event. event_description : str Full description (may contain newlines or other formatting). event_date : str Date of the event. additional_notes : str Any user‑provided notes about the event. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string ready for rendering in a browser. """ # Escape all user supplied data to avoid XSS attacks safe_title = html.escape(event_title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(event_description, quote=False).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(event_date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(additional_notes, quote=False).replace("\n", "
") return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes )
